tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzungs grwa lnga'i dkyil chog bar chad kun sel bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba ston pa shākya seṅge ni/ / gzungs kyi lha mor bcas la gus btud nas/ / srung ba lnga yi gzungs mdo'i dgongs pa mchog /lag len cho ga'i snying po 'dir bshad bya/ / de la 'di ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i nang tshan bya ba'i rgyud la/ rigs drug yod pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs so/ /de la yang nang tshan mang du yod pa las/ rigs kyi lha mo'i rgyud sder gtogs so/ /de las stong chen rab 'joms dang*/ rma bya chen mo dang*/ so sor 'brang ma dang/ gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang*/ bsil ba'i tshal chen mo te/ lnga po 'di la srung ba lnga'am/ gzungs grwa lngar grags la/ lnga po de dag chabs gcig par byed pa'i khungs ni/ stong chen gyi 'jug gi cha dang*/ sor 'brang gi dbus kyi cha na gsal lo/ / de bas na rgyud tha dad nas bshad pa yin pas so sor yang sgrub tu rung la/ chabs gcig tu bsgom zhing sgrub pa ni ches mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /de la rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor khyad par can yang bzhugs mod kyi/ 'dir rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ rin chen 'byung gnas zhi ba'i sgrub thabs la brten zhing lo pan gyi man ngag rgyun ma chad pa bla ma gong ma rnams kyis yig rigs mang po mdzad pa la brten nas bri bar bya'o/ /de la dang por sngon 'gro gtor ma/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/

lan gsum brjod/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma len pa'i gnas su ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ/ a d+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog ces pa'i bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ tshig lhug pas 'phrin las gzhol ba spyi dang 'dra/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te gtor ma sa gtsang ba'i phyogs su dor ro/ /spyir bya spyod rang rkang gi lugs la gnas khang byin rlabs mi dgos kyang*/ rgyud sde gong ma dang sgo bstun nas sgrub pa'i lugs 'di rigs la/ de byed pa bzang bas gnas yo byin rlabs bya ste/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ slar yang oṃ las byung ba'i/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil / me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag rnams/ rang bzhin gnyis su med pa'i ye shes/ rnam pa mchod rdzas kyi sprin phung*/ byed las rang bzhin 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha thams cad zag med kyi bde ba chen pos tshim par byed pa/ yul dang dus yongs su chad pa med par 'jug pa/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i/ mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du/ dhū pe ā lo ke gen+dha nai we d+ya/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/

oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya a brta ya hoḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi sho mu khe bh+yaḥ sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags ring po gong bzhin te/ sngags tshan gsum po de lan gsum gsum brjod/ rol chen dang bcas te/ na mo bha ga wa te badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha na ye/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyaka saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ mahā badz+re mahā te dza badz+re/ mahā bod+dhi tsit+ta badz+re/ mahā bo dhi man+ṭa u pa saṃ kra ma ṇe sarba karma a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swāhā/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra ba dang*/ 'gro rnams sgral 'dod bsam pa yis sogs sam/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ sogs rang rung zhig brjod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung ba'o/ / rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ praṃ yig dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can/ de las 'od 'phros/ srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bla ma mchog dang bcom ldan so sor 'brang ma dang*/ /stong chen rab 'joms de bzhin rma bya chen mo dang*/ /gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal te lha mo lnga/ /'khor dang bcas la sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa de ba tsakra maṇ+ḍa la sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me bha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ de bzhin du/ ar+ghaṃ gyis gnas su/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/dhu pe/ā lo ke/gan+dhe/nai wi te/ shap+ta zhes pa rnams bcug la mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags bya/ rdzu 'phrul tshad dang ldan pa lha mo lnga rnams la/ /lha gang mngon par rab tu dang pa yod pa yi/ /lha de mgu zhing yid ni rab tu dga' gyur te/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems kyis bdag la srung du gsol/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

sogs tshad med bzhi spyi dang 'dra/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba'i lte ba la hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og rdo rje sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje gur dang bla re/ phyi rol rdo rje'i dra ba dang*/ ye shes kyi med dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po dbus su gzhu'i dbyibs kyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po dbus su gru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po dbus su zlum pos mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po dbus su gru bzhis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du suṃ las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā ga /byang gser las grub pa/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa'o/ /de'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu ser po dang*/ dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa'i sa dang bya 'dabs las thur du dpyangs pa'i shar bu'i 'phreng ba dang*/ steng du mda' yab dang*/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa/ sgo dang sgo 'khyud kyi 'tshams la zla phyed rdo rje dang*/ steng thog legs par phub pa'i dbus kyi rtse mo/ /rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa'o/ /nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ lho ser nub dmar byang ljang*/ dbus dkar ba'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de'i steng du praṃ yig dkar la ser ba'i mdangs can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma/ sku mdog dkar la yid tsam ser ba/ dbu la mchod rten gyis brgyan pa/ rtsa zhal dkar ser/ g.yas nag /rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba'i zhal bzhi pa/ zhal re re la zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas dang pos 'khor lo/ /gnyis pas rdo rje gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas ral gri g.yon dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa/ gnyis pas rtse gsum/ gsum pas gzhu/ bzhi pas dgra sta 'dzin pa/ zla ba'i gdan la zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ lo ma dang*/ 'dab ma dang*/ 'bras bu rgyas pa'i byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ / shar du hūṃ las stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma/ sku mdog dang*/ rtsa zhal sngon mo/ /g.yas dkar/ rgyab ser/ g.yon dmar ba'i zhal bzhi/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa ljags 'gril ba/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin lcags kyu mda' dang ral gri/ g.yon bzhi na zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ dgra sta gzhu dang rin po che zur drug pas mtshan pa'i pad+ma rnams 'dzin pa/ drag mo'i tshul can/ stag lpags kyi shams thabs dang*/ sbrul dang rin po che dang rus 'phreng gis brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ nyi ma la g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs shing*/ me dpung gi rgyab yol can/ shing n+ya gro dha'i sdong po la rgyab bsten pa'o/ /lhor maṃ yig las rma bya chen mo gser gyi mdog can ser nag /dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ spyan gsum gsum gyis mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas bzhi na mchog sbyin/ rin po che'i rgyun 'bab pa'i bum pa/

'khor lo ral gri g.yon bzhi na lhung bzed kyi nang du gnas pa'i dge slong*/ rma bya'i mjug sgro/ sna tshogs rdo rjes kha rgyan pa'i bum pa/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan rnams 'dzin pa/ mya ngan med pa'i shing drung na bzhugs pa'o/ /nub tu shaṃ las gsang sngags rjes su 'brang ma sku mdog dmar skya/ dmar nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum/ spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ gnyis pa gnyis mnyam bzhag /lhag ma g.yas bzhi mchog sbyin/ skyabs sbyin rdo rje/ mda' g.yon bzhi zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ pad+mas brgyan pa'i bum pa/ rin po che'i snye ma dang gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ shing shi ri sha'i sdong po la rgyab bsten pa'o/ /byang du gaṃ las bsil ba tshal chen mo ljang khu/ ljang dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum/ spyan gnyis gnyis dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas gsum mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje dang mda'/ g.yon gsum zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub dang*/ rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ gzhu rnams shing shing tsam pa ka'i sdong po la rgyab bsten pa la/ de gsum char yang sems ma'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dbu skra nag po phyed bcings phyed grol ba/ gtso mo dang mtshungs par bzla gdan dang*/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can/ stong chen ma gtogs pa gtso 'khor bzhi char yang rab tu zhi ba/ dar sna tshogs pa'i nam bza' dang*/ mu tig gi do shal la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la/ rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba/ dpag bsam shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa re re'o/ /gtso 'khor lnga char gyi/ dpral par oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ nag po thugs ka'i dbus rnams su/ praṃ huṃ maṃ shaṃ gaṃ rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba'o/ / sa bon rnams las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/

oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas/ nai wi te 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros dbang gi lha rigs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa= sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta abhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs/ ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis sku lus gang*/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ gtso 'khor thams cad la rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan/ de nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa sogs gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid mchog /dung dang kun da'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /so sor 'brang ma phyag 'tshal bstod/ kha dog nag mo mi bzad 'jigs/ /rngam zhing zhal 'gyur khro gnyer can/ /gdul dka'i 'byung po yang dag 'dul/ /rdo rje khro mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lha mo ye shes las byung che/ /gser gyi 'od ltar rab 'bar ba'i/ /rma bya che la rab dad pas// rig pa'i rgyal mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /pad+ma kha phye'i zhal mnga' ba/ /zhal mdzes ma la spyan yangs shing*/ /pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba'i/ /'gro ba'i mar gyur phyag 'tshal bstod/ /mthing ga nam mkha'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags kyis sgeg ma/ /dug rnams 'joms par byed pa mo/ /sku mdzes ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi mahā pra ti sā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ so sor 'brang ma'i 'o/ / oṃ a mṛ ta wa re wa ra pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ stong chen mo'i 'o/ / oṃ a mṛ ta bu lo ki ni gar+bha sa ma rak+ṣa ṇi a kar+ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ rma bya chen mo'i 'o/ / oṃ bi ma le bi pū le dza ya wa re a mṛ ta bi ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/

gsang sngags rjes 'dzin gyi'o/ / oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra in+d+ri ya ba la bi shwa dha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ru ru tsa le swāhā/ bsil ba'i tshal gyi'o/ /de nas yang ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar phyis mchod/ spro na gong bzhin bstod pa'am/ sor sor 'brang dang stong chen rab 'joms dang*/ /rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes su 'brang*/ /bsil ba'i tshal te ye shes lnga yi sku/ /gzungs sngags rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pas bstod/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis drangs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ma lus pa bdag nyid kyi thugs kar thim/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ /bsod nams ye shes las 'byung ba'i/ /dam pa gnyis po thob par shog / ces pa ni bdag bskyed do/ /de nas 'byung po spyi gtor gcig bshams/ sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu dang*/ mchod gtor yang sgrigs nas/ oṃ a mṛ te huṃ phaṭa/ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gong sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs bzhin las rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs kyi tshab tu/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis blang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /

zhes dril gsil dang bcas te lan gsum gsol ba btab la phyir rol du dor/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa thogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sa gzhi'i dbus pad+ma dkar po'i nang nas lus kyi phyed phyung ba/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhuṃ baṃ hoḥ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod= ces pa nas/ s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ gi bar gong bzhin mchod par byin rlabs bya/ oṃ pri thi wī de bī sa pā ri wa ra zhes mgo bor sbyar nas ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du pā d+yaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe aḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar/ oṃ pri thi bi de bī/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ zhes pa nas/ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta swāhā/ lan lnga'am/ bdun la sogs pas phul/ dril gsil dang bcas te/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seṅge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ lan gsum/ rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig /sa'i lha mo slar yang sa de nyid la thim/ sa blang ba'o/ / oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa ces mang du bzla zhing*/ yungs kar dar thal bas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la gtor ro// dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med pa byang chub kyi sems kyi ngo bo'o/ / sa sbyangs ba'o/ /dri bzang gi chu la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs gtso mo'i sngags nyer gcig tsam dang*/ a mṛ ta brgya tsam bzlas/ chu de ku shas blangs te dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'thor bzhin du/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta be ra sogs/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo sogs/ oṃ bi ma le

sogs/ oṃ bha ra sogs/ sngags rnams lan bdun bdun sogs ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ sa'i phyogs 'dir rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis dkyil 'khor chen po bri bar bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod/ de ni sa bzung ba ste/ de dag ni sa'i cho ga'o//de nas dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir dri'i thig le'am/ yang na me tog tsam bkram/ mchod pa bshams*/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yig ge bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i zhing khams rnam par dag pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i pad+ma dang nyi ma dang*/ zla ba la sogs pa lha'i gdan dpag tu med pas gtams par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa la sogs pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rig pa'i rgyal po dang*/ pho nya dang phyag brnyan gyi tshogs thams cad dang*/ khyad par tu yang bcom ldan ma srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'og dngos gzhi'i skabs su 'byung ba ltar/ ma lus sems can kun gyi zhes pa nas/ tiṣ+ṭhān+tu swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mchod pa a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ zhes pa nas/ sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /shap+ta 'i bar dang*/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung*/ zhes sogs kyi gong bzhin bstod cing*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa zhes sogs sho lo ka gsum dang*/ gzhan yang spro na sangs rgyas byang sems kyi spyi bstod ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ de nas lha'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa lnga'am/ ma 'byor na gcig gis kyang rung la/ khrus kyi bum pa gcig bshams te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs sam/ rang gi mdun du bshams/ gzhan bum pa bshams lugs spyi dang 'dra/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ paṃ las byung pa'i ye shes kyi bum pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ nang ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang ba'i steng bum pa'i bstod kyi cha la/

paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte ba zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu rgyan gyi bar/ bdag bskyed gtso 'khor lnga char bskyed/ rang nyid ces pa dor/ gzungs thag nas bzung la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri sogs snying po'i sngags lnga po re re bzhin brgya rtsa las mi nyung ba bzla/ khrus bum la a mṛ ta brgya rtsa dang*/ thun mong du a bhi ṣe ka ེ'i sngags kyang bzla/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa sogs tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya lan gsum sogs ji ltar 'os pa dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes/ dung chos kyi chu dang me tog 'bul/ badz+ra muḥ zhes/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ de nas bdug spos brdul zhing*/ dril gsil dang bcas te/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga/ /rigs sngags rgyal mo phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bdag phyag 'tshal/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnang bar mdzad pa'i rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang*/ /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ /'byung po'i byang chub bstan gnas dang*/ /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ /che ge 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pas nyer spyod pa/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir 'bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bas nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar 'byon par mdzad pa'i rigs/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slar yang*/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na/ sogs pa/

ji snyed bcom ldan 'das ma'i tshogs/ zhes bsgyur te/ mchod pa dang*/ gong bzhin bstod/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams gong bum bskyed kyi skabs dang 'dra ste/ de dag ni sta gon gyi cho ga yin la/ spyir lha sta gon gyi rigs la/ dkyil 'khor nges pa'i lhag gnas dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa'i lhag gnas gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ni/ phal cher la yongs su grags pa de yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir bkod pa lta bu de spros pa chung ba'i lugs so/ /gal te slob ma la dbang bskur na skabs 'dir/ rgyud sde 'og ma'i lugs kyi slob ma sta gon yang byas na legs te/ gsang ba spyi'i rgyud las de byed par gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'on kyang lag len bsdus pa'i skabs su ni/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len ltar ma byas kyang rung tsam yin no/ /gal te byed na dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa'i cho gar blta'o/ /de nas thigs skud dang rngul mtshon legs par bkrus/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i thig skud dang rdul tshon rnams dang bcas shing thogs pa med par gyur/ a mṛ ta 'i sngags brgya rtsa sogs dang*/ lha mo lnga po'i snying po rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzla/ yi ge brgya pas brtan par byas te/ a mṛ ta bzla bzhin pas thig btab/ ye thig dang las thig gi dbye ba 'di la mi dgos/ de'i 'og tu gtso mo'i snying po bzla bzhin tu rdul mtshon 'gyed de dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'o/ /mthar/ rdul tshon dang thig skud kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas rang gi lus la thim par mos/ a mṛ ta dang snying po mang du bzlas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ de nas yig brgya bzlas shing rdo rje gsor dril bu dkrol/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad bsal bar mos so/ 'dir dkyil 'khor cung zad bsdus pa ni/ bdag skyed ji lta ba bzhin du/ lha lnga tsam gyis kyang cho ga ste/ de'i tshe phyogs skyong gza' skar rgyal chen sogs gtor mgron gyi lha tsam du byed pa yin te/

de ltar byas na'ang gzhung gi dgongs pa dang mthun zhing shin tu legs par 'gyur ro/ /'on kyang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag ltar byed pa ni dkyus su 'byung ba 'di nyid do/ /de nas rgyan dgram pa ni spros pa la mi dga' na/ mchod gtor bzang du bshams/ 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas/ sa rgyan gnam rgyan ci rigs pa tsam bkod pas chog go / cung zad spraus pa la dga' na/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ gdan gru bzhi brtan pa re bzhag la/ de la mda' brgyad btsugs/ tshon skud sna lnga'i dra ba bya ste/ dbang ldan gyi mda'i rtsa ba ste mde'u phyogs la mtshon skud kyi sne mo dam du btags nas/ de'i shar gyi mda'i ltong rtse mor dkris/ de'i shar lho'i rtsa bar 'then zhing dkris/ rim pa de kha'i phyogs bzhi'i rtse mo dang*/ mtshams bzhi'i rtsa ba 'then pa las/ byang gi rtse nas rtsa ba'i bar du mthen te dkris nas/ slar byang shar gyi rtse mor 'then pa sogs/ mtshams bzhi'i rtse mo dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i rtsa bar dkri'o/ /de nas yang byang gi rtsa ba nas rtse mo bar du 'then zhing ltong la dkris nas/ byang gi rtsa nas shar lhor btang shar lho nas nub tu btang ba sogs/ 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi rnam par bris/ mthar mda' brgyad po'i ltong nas ltong gi bar du skor te 'khor lo'i mu khyud kyi rnam par byas nas/ sne mo ni byang shar gyi mda'i rtsa bar drangs nas bsdu'o/ /phur pa brgyad dang*/ ral gri brgyad rtse mor thur du bstan la/ mda' re re'i 'khris su btsugs/ me long brgyad/ rma bya'i mdongs brgyad/ 'phan brgyad rnams kyang mda'i rtse mor btags/ phyogs bzhi'i mda' la rgyal chen bzhi'i tsa ka li bkram mo/ /de dag yongs rdzogs ma 'byor na/ ji ltar 'byor bas chog go /re re nas mtha' gcig tu med mi rung ba ma yin no/ / da lta ni ras bris kyi phyogs la mda' mtshon gyi drwa ba byed cing*/

rdul tshon la mi byed pa mang mod thob thang ni rdul tshon la dgos kyis ras bris la med kyang chog go /byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog/ shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs gsil sogs mchod pa skor te bshams kyang chog/ dkyil 'khor gyi g.yas su gtor mgo yang mdun bskyed nyid kyi g.yas su bstan te/ 'das gtor gcig go /phyogs skyong bcu la gcig /rgyal chen bzhi la re re/ gza' la gcig /rgyu skar la gcig /yang dkar gtor gnyis/ dmar gtor lnga/ yang klu dang 'byung po bzhi bdag gsum la dkar gtor re re/ bgegs gtor gcig go /de ltar na gtor ma bco brgyad gral sgṛgs su bya/ rgyal chen gyi sdebs la dbus kyi gtor ma byed na bcu dgu'o/ /chos skyong dgos kyi gtor ma byed na zur du bshams/ re re bzhin ras dkar po'i ba dan 'dzugs/ de nas dngos gzhi'i cho ga ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ dam pa gnyis po thob par shog gi bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par sgoms/ de rjes spro na mdun bskyed la bgegs sbyang ba/ sdig pa sbyang ba/ khrus gsol ba sogs kyang bya ste/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas/ dbus dkar ba'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i gdan/ yang de'i dbus su/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma= zhes pa nas/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa re re'o/ / zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las rang nyid ces pa dor/ phyi rol gyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du tshangs pa dang brgya sbyin shar lhor me lha/ lhor gshin rje/ lho nub du srin po/ nub tu chu lha dang*/ sa'i lha mo/ nub byang rlung lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ byang du dbang ldan te phyogs skyong bcu'o/

/ de'i phyi rol 'khor lo'i rtsibs brgyad pa rnams la/ shar du nyi ma dang*/ zla ba/ shar lhor mig dmar/ lhor gza' lhag /lho nub tu phur bu/ nub tu pa sangs/ nub byang du spen pa/ byang sgra gcan lus phyed shin rta la gnas pa/ byang shar du du ba mjug rings so/ /de'i phyi rol lha rnams kyi steng zlum por skor ba la/ shar du smin drug snar ma mgo lag nam so/ rgyal/ skag rnams sku mdog dkar ba/ lhor mchu/ bre/ dbo/ me bzhi/ nag pa/ sa ri/ sa ga /rnams sku mdog ser po/ nub tu lha 'tshams/ snon snubs chu stod chu smad gro zhin/ byi zhin rnams sku mdog dmar mo/ byang du min bre/ min gru khrums stod/ khrums smad/ nam gru/ rgyal/ tha skar/ bra nye rnams sku mdog ljang khu'o/ /thams cad kyang lha mo'i lus can/ thal mo spyi bor sbyar ba bstan nang tshangs can la bzhugs pa'o// shar sgor rgyal po yul 'khor srung*/ lho sgor rgyal po 'phags skyes po/ nub sgor rgyal po spyan mi bzang*/ byang sgor rgyal po rnam thos bu rnams/ rang rang gi 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas te bzhugs par gyur/ de nas rang sngags kyi lhar sgrub pa ni/ dbus kyi gtso mo lnga la/ ma ṇi dha ra ི sogs sngags tshan lnga po re re bzhin lan bdun bdun dang*/ lhag ma 'jig brten pa'i sngags 'di rnams la lan gsum gsum byed de/ oṃ in+d+ra ye swāhā/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ oṃ ya ma ye swāhā/ oṃ ni ri ti ye swāhā/ oṃ ba ru ṇā ya swāhā/ oṃ ba ya be swāhā/ oṃ ku bai rā ya swāhā/ oṃ i shā na ye swāhā/ oṃ pra h+mā swāhā/ oṃ pra thi bī di bī swāhā/ phyogs skyong rnams so/ oṃ mai go lka ye swāhā/ oṃ shī tāṃ sha be swāhā/ oṃ rak+ṣa aṃ ga ku ma ra swāhā/ oṃ bud+dha ya swāhā/ oṃ pri haspa he swāhā/ oṃ shu kra ya swāhā/ /oṃ kṛṣ+ṇa bar+ṇa swāhā/ oṃ a mṛ ta pri ya swāhā/ oṃ dz+yo ti ke ta we swāhā/

gza' rnams so/ / oṃ kirti ka swāhā/ oṃ ro hi ṇi swāhā/ oṃ mri ga shī ra swāhā/ oṃ a ra dra swāhā/ oṃ pu na ra ba su swāhā/ oṃ pu+u ṣ+ya swāhā/ oṃ asma shā swāhā/ oṃ ma gha swāhā/ oṃ purba pha la gu ni swāhā/ oṃ uta te ra pha lku ne swāhā/ oṃ hasta swāhā/ oṃ tsi tra swāhā/ oṃ swa sti swāhā/ oṃ bī shā kha swāhā/ oṃ a nu rat+dza swāhā/ oṃ dze ṣ+ta swāhā/ oṃ mū la swāhā/ oṃ pur+wa a shan+dha swāhā/ oṃ uta ta ra a shar+dha swāhā/ oṃ shra ma ṇā swāhā/ oṃ a bhe tā swāhā/ oṃ dha niṣ+ti swāhā/ oṃ sha ta bhe ṣā swāhā/ oṃ surba bha dra pa da swāhā/ oṃ ud ta ra bha dra ra da swāhā/ oṃ re ba ti swāhā/ oṃ i shā+e ne swāhā/ oṃ bha ra ṇi swāhā/ skar ma rnams kyi'o/ / oṃ dh+rī ti raṣ+ta ya swāhā/ oṃ bi ru ḍha kā ya swāhā/ oṃ bi ru pā k+ṣa ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇā ya swāhā/ rgyal chen bzhi'i 'o/ / gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ= nas/ hūṃ nag po/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

tshigs bcad re re'i mthar dril gsil dang bcas rdo rje g.yab cing*/ dbyangs dang bcas pa'am med kyang rung ste/ chos dbyings rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i ngang*/ /kun du khyab pa'i gnas mchog sdug po dang*/ /rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams rab 'byams nas/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor mtha' dag gshegs su gsol/ /bde gshegs kun kyi thugs rje stobs nyid dang*/ /bdag cag dad pa'i bsam pa rnam dag pas/ /thugs dam bskul zhing spyan 'dren gsol 'debs na/ /'gro ba'i don phyir gnas 'dir byon tu gsol/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya ma nyams shing*/ /rjes mthun mchod pa yo byad thams cad tshang*/ /'gro ba'i don gyi dus la'ang babs lags na/ /srid zhi'i rgyud pa bsal phyir gshegs su gsol/ /rigs sngags rgyal mo stong chen rma bya che/ /'khor lo'i gtso mo bcom ldan so sor 'brang*/ /thub dkar gsang sngags rjes 'dzin bsil ba'i tshal/ /gzungs kyi lha mo 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyon/ /ma lus sems can kun kyi mgon gyur cing*/ / zhes pa nas/ yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan thugs rjes byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal par ldan/ / bdag gi mchod yon bzhes gnas su/ /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra aghaṃ swāhā/ ji ltar bltams pa= zhes pa nas/ sa ma ya shri hūṃ gis khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs so gsol/ /oṃ ā sa na taṇ+ṣān+tu swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha aḥ yang gtso mo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan/ yang na/ 'jig rten pa'i lha rnams la gtso mo'i dbu rgyan par byas kyang rung ngo*/

/de nas mchod pa a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa dha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod= ces pa nas/ bi sho dha ni swāhā 'i bar gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag gis mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*/ /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ta pañtsa rak+ṣa de ba ta sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ mchod yonazhes par zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ zhes par pād+yaṃ sbyar te zhabs gsil 'bul/ gtsang zhing gtsang mar skyes pa yi/ /me tog dam pa 'dir dag ni/ bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ puṣ+pe= dri yis rgyas pa lha yi rdzas/ /nags tshal bcud ni yid 'ong 'di/ /bdag gi dad pas= bzhes nas bdag= dhu pe= gdon rnams 'joms shing bkra shis la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel 'di/ /bdag gis= bzhes nas= ā lo ke= / gtsang zhing gtsang ma las byung ba'i/ /lha rdzas bzang po'i dri 'di dag /bdag gis= bzhes nas= gan+dhe= sman rnams bcud ni yid gar 'ong*/ /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /bdag gis= bzhes nas= nai wi t+ya= de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ sems can sdug bsngal tshim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig shap+ta= lha rdzas las grub lte ba shin tu zlum/ zhes pa nas/ 'khor lo rin chen nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul/ tsakra rat+na pu dza me gha= sogs/ des mtshon te/ dmag dpon gyi bar la sbyar ro// de nas/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan 'phreng ldan/ zhes sogs 'dod yon lnga'i tshigs bcad spyi dang 'dra bas phul/ sngags rnams gong gis rigs 'gre ste/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa rak+ṣa de ba tā sa pā ri wā ra spar sha kā ma gu ṇa pu dza me ga sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ zhes pa lta bu'o/

/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /srung ba lnga 'dus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ maṅga la aṣ+ta dra bya/ zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro/ /yang de dang 'dra ba las/ bkra shis rtags brgyad ces dang*/ maṅga la aṣ+ta aṃ ga zhes bsgyur ro/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ gzugs phung gnas gyur gti mug rnam dag pa/ /me long ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi sku yi rigs las byung*/ /so sor 'brang ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gdong bzhi zhi ba dga' byed gos ser can/ / mkha' lding klu dbang gnod sbyin dri za dang*/ /mi 'am ci yi tshogs kyis gus mchod pa/ /byang chub shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyon mongs zhags pas 'ching ba gcod mdzad cing*/ /gzhan gyi sngags dang phyag rgya rdzas sbyor dang*// byad stems byed dang drag shul rnam pa kun/ /rab tu 'joms pa khyod la= dkon mchog la mchod mngon par brtson pa dang*/ /brtse bas gzhan don gcig tu lhur len zhing*/ /theg pa mchog gi brtul bzhugs 'dzin pa rnams/ /yongs su skyong pa khyod la= rnam shes gnas gyur zhe sdang rnam dag la/ /chos dbyings ye shes las byung lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi rigs las byung*/ / stong chen rab 'joms zhabs la= nyi mar rol pas 'gegs dang 'byung po mnan/ /ma mo bdun dang srin mo sha za mo/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams rab tu skrag mdzad ma/ /bha ṭa'i shing drung bzhugs la= rlung dang bad kan mkhris pa'i nad sel zhing*/ / thog dang ser ba rlung sogs gnod pa sel/ /dus min 'chi ba nges par 'joms mdzad ma/ /'jigs byed khro mo'i zhabs la= tshor ba gnas gyur ser sna rnam dag pa/ /mnyam nyid ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rigs las byung*/ /rma bya chen mo'i= bden pa grub pa'i drang srong rnams kyi mchod/

/srin mo'i tshogs 'joms klu rnams skrag mdzad cing*/ /lha ma yin rnams kun tu rmongs byed pa/ /mya ngan med pa'i shing drung bzhugs la 'dud/ / brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams rab 'joms shing*/ /dmod pa'i mda' dang 'khrul 'khor 'jigs par byed/ /sgrub po dri med bde la 'god mdzad pa/ / rigs sngags rgyal mo'i zhabs la= /'du shes gnas gyur 'dod chags rnam dag pa/ /kun rtogs ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gi rigs las byung*/ /gsang sngags rjes su 'dzin la= 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis zhabs mchod cing*/ /rgyal chen bzhi yis rtag par rim gro byed/ /rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi gus btud pa/ /shir sha'i shing drung bzhugs la= ye shes sgyu ma'i sprul pa rnam rol zhing*/ sngags kyi sbyor bas 'gro ba yongs su 'dzin/ /lha dang lha min klu dbang tshogs rnams kun/ /dbang du mdzad pa khyod la= 'du byed gnas gyur phrag dog rnam dag pa/ /bya grub ye shes rang bzhin lha mo'i sku/ / rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las rigs las byung*/ /bsil ba'i tshal gyi zhabs la= lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin gyis mchod cing*/ /smyo byed brjed byed la sogs 'byung po'i tshogs/ /kun tu skrag mdzad bya yi gdon rnams 'joms/ /tsam pa'i shing drung bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug pa dang*/ /skrad dang dbye ba bsad pa la sogs te/ /las rnams thams cad so sor stsol mdzad pa/ /don kun sgrub byed ma la= glang chen sa srungs bu la ni/ /rol ba'i bzhugs pa gser mdog can/ /rdo rje 'chang pa lha yi rje/ /brgya sbyin la yang phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnams par bsgyings pa'i ma he la/ /mnyam par gnas pa a bh+ra mdog /be con 'chang ba ma mo'i rje/ /gshin rje la yang = chu srin la gnas chu shel mdog /nor bu dang bcas gdeng kas rgyan/ /sbrul zhags 'dzin pa klu yi rje/ /chu lha la yang phyag 'tshal=

/rta mchog bzhon pa gser mdog can/ /nor bus mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dang*/ /ne'u le 'dzin pa gnod spyin rje/ /lus ngan po la= khyu mchog la gnas 'jigs chen po/ /phyugs bdag chen po kun da'i mdog /rtse gsum 'chang ba 'byung po'i rje/ /dbang ldan la yang = ra skyes zhon zhing ches dmar ba/ /mchog sbyin dbyug gu bgrang 'phreng dang*/ /ghun+dhā 'dzin pa drang srong che/ /me yi lha la= gad rgyangs sgrogs pa'i ro langs la/ /brtan par gnas pa char sprin mdog ral gri 'chang ba srin po'i rje/ /bden bral la yang = shin tu mgyogs pa'i ri dwags kyi/ /bzhon pa la gnas mar gad mdog /ba dan 'dzin pa rig 'dzin rje/ /rlung gi lha la= ngang pa'i rgyal po la gnas pa/ /gser mdog gdong bzhi pad+ma dang*/ /bgrang 'phreng ghun rde glegs bam 'dzin/ /skye rgu'i mes por= phag la zhon zhing brtan par gnas/ /shin tu 'bar ba'i gser mdog can/ /bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin/ /skye rgu'i ma la= li khri'i mdog mtshungs rab mdzes shing*/ /shing rta'i steng na nyi dkyil bzhugs/ /pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu 'dzin/ /gzi brjid rgyas la= kun da ltar dkar zla ba ni/ /bsil zer byed pa'i dbus na bzhugs/ /ku mud ta yi sdong bu 'dzin/ /zhi mdzad de la= mig dmar pad+ma rā ga'i mdog /ra skyes bzhon zhing khro tshul can/ /gri gug dang ni mi mgo 'dzin/ /mthu chen de la= gza' lhag mar gad ltar ljang zhing*/ /pad+ma la gnas zhi ba'i sku/ /mdzes shing rab sgeg mda' gzhu 'dzin/ bde mdzad de la= drang srong phur bu gser mdog can/ /glang chen steng na rol pas bzhugs/ bgrang 'phreng rol ba spyi blugs 'dzin/ /thugs rje can la= pa sangs gangs ri'i mdog mtshungs pa/ /pad+ma la gnas bzhad pa'i zhal/ /shel 'phreng dang ni ril ba 'dzin/ /phan mdzad de la= spen pa mig sman ltar gnag cing*/ /lho phye la zhon 'jigs pa'i tshul/ /'phreng pa dang ni dbyug gu 'dzin/ /mthu chen de la=

lha min dbang po sgra gcan ni/ /sku mdog dmar nag 'jigs chen po/ /phyag gnyis nyi ma zla ba 'dzin/ /stobs chen de la= mjug rings brag ri'i steng na bzhugs/ kha dog skya sangs drag po'i gzugs/ /sbrul zhags dang ni ral gri 'dzin/ /gtum chen de la= gang dag shar gyi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*/ /mgo lag nam so rgyal skag la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /lho yi phyogs na 'khod pa yi/ /mchu dang bre dbo me bzhi dang*/ /nag pa sa ga sa ri dang*/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /gang dag nub kyi phyogs gnas pa'i/ /lha 'tshams snon snrubs chu stod dang*/ /chu smad byi bzhin gro zhun la/ /mchod cing = byang phyogs gnas pa'i mon gre dang*/ /mon gru khrum stod khrum smad dang*/ /nam gru tha skar bra nye la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal po chen po dpal ldan pa/ /mar gad mdog mtshungs pi waṃ 'dzin/ /dri za'i tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ /yul 'khor srung la= dpa' bo chen po stobs po che/ kha dog sngon po ral gri 'dzin/ /grul bu tshogs la dbang bsgyur pa/ /'phags skyes po la= mnga' bdag chen po mthu bo che/ kha dog dmar po sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /klu yi tshogs la dbang bsgyur ba/ mig mi bza' la= sde dpon chen po gser mdog can/ /be con dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin tshogs la dbang bskyur ba/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas gtor ma rnams chus sbyangs/ bgegs gtor la ni chang yang sgron/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swābhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por 'gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa mu khe bh+yeḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud ga de s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs ltar byin gyis rlabs/

oṃ ma ni dhā ri badz+ri ṇi mahā pra ti sā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas so sor 'brang ma la 'bul/ de'i rigs 'gres te/ oṃ a mṛ ta ba re pra wa ra bi shud+dhe hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ oṃ a ka ro sogs dang*/ £© oṃ ā mṛ ta bi lo ki ni gar+bhas ma rak+ṣa ṇi a kar+ṣa ṇi hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ a kā ro= sogs dang*/ £© oṃ bi ma le bi pu le bi pū le dza ya wa re a mṛ ta bi ra dze hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ £¨¡¶dzaṃ¡·+ a kā ro= sogs dang*/ £© oṃ bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra in+d+ra ya pa la bi shwa dha ni hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa ru ru tsa la swāhā/ oṃ a kā ro mu= btags te/ bcom ldan 'das ma bzhi po ma 'bul lo/ / ar+ghaṃ= nas shap+ta 'i bar sngags rgyas bsdus gang rung gis mchod/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /'gro ba'i dug lnga sel mdzad pa/ /srung ba'i 'phrin las bla na med/ /lha mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i bar gyis 'phrin las gzhol/ bar 'dir sgrub pa po rang nyid bsten cing sgrub pa'i chos skyong rnams kyi gtor bsngo bya/ de nas phyogs skyong gi gtor ma cha gsum gyi nang bzhin phul/ de nas rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor ma ni/ oṃ ḍhi ta raṣ+ta ye zhes pa la/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥbi shwa= zhes pa nas/ ga ga ṇa khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ/ ta ye swāhā/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin dang*/ /'jig rten skyong dang dbang phyug che/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon thams cad dang*/ /'phrog ma bu dang bcas rnams kyis/ /bdag gis me tog spos rnams dang*/ /gtor ma 'di ni blang bar mdzod/

/de rnams kyi ni btson 'grus dang*/ /gzi brjid dbang phyug stobs kyis kyang*/ /nad rnams thams cad 'joms gyur cig /bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad/ shar phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ rgyal po chen po yul 'khor srung gi ming dang stobs dang dbang phyug dang gzi byin gyis/ bdag cag slob dpon yon mchod rnams gdon thams cad dang gnod pa thams cad las thar bar gyur cig swāhā/ zhes so/ stod smad kun tu bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams zhes sogs kyi tshab tu gzhan dmigs bsal yod na de'i ming bcug /cho ga des gzhan gsum la'ang rigs 'gres te/ oṃ bi ru dha ka ya na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ tshangs pa dang ni= nas/ lho phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ rgyal po chen po 'phags skyed po'i ming dang*/ zhes pa nas/ thar bar gyur cig swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ bi ru pak+ṣa ya nā maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ tshangs pa dang ni= nas/ nub phyogs su bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ rgyal po chen po mig mi bzang gi ming dang = nas/ thar bar gyur cig swāhā/

de bzhin du/ oṃ baishra ba ṇa ye na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ tshangs pa dang ni= nas/ byang phyogs su bde legs su 'gyur cig swāhā/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos bu'i ming dang*/ nas/ thar bar gyur cig swāhā/ de nas dbus kyi gtor ma byed de/ gong phyogs skyong gi nang du tshang bas logs su med kyang chog mod/ byed par spro na/ oṃ pra mahā ba su dha ri ṇi na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ tshangs pa dang ni= nas/ steng dang 'og dang phyogs mtshams thams cad du bde legs su gyur cig swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang tshangs pa dang sa'i lha rnams kyi ming dang*/ nas/ thar bar gyur cig swāhā/ zhes bya te/ skabs 'dir sgrub pa po dpon slob phyogs so sor 'gro bar bya ba srol yod mod phyi rol du mtho rtsigs yod na de bzhin du bya la/ /med na de ltar mi dgos so/ /de nas gza' dang skar ma'i gtor ma ni/ oṃ me golka ya swāhā/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ bha ra ṇi swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar la 'grub na sngags re re bzhin/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum gsum gyis 'bul/ bsdu na sngags rnams stebs gcig tu brjod pa'i mthar/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags tshar gcig btags pa lan gsum gyi gza' skar rnams la 'bul/ oṃ nyi ma dang ni zla ba dang*/ /phur bu dang ni pa sangs/ /dman pa bkra shis lhag pa dang*/ /sgra gcan du ba mjug rings te/ /'jig rten du ni zad 'phel byed/ gzi chen rdzu 'phrul chen po dag / rab tu dang ba'i sems kyi su/ /rigs sngags rjes su yi rang byos/ /de dag gis kyang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la srung bar gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig /smin drug dang ni snar ma dang*/ /mgo dang lag dang nam so dang*/ rgyal ni bkra shis phun sum tshogs/ / de ltar skag te bdun po yin/

de ltar rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ shar gyi phyogs na gnas pa dag ste/ shar phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la srung bar gyis shig /lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar shog shig / 'dis 'og ma sde tshan gsum la'ang rigs 'gre ste/ mchu ni mi zad 'joms pa dang*/ /de bzhin bre dang dbo dang ni/ /me bzhi nag pa sa ri dang*//sa ga de ltar bdun po'o/ / de ltar rgyu skar bdun po de dag ni/ lho'i phyogs na gnas pa dag ste/ lho phyogs skyong zhing srung bar byed pa dag go /de dag gis kyang bdag cag= nas/ mthong bar shog cig /lha 'tshams gzi brjid chen mo dang*/ /de bzhin snron dang snrubs dang ni/ /chu stod dang ni chu smad dang*/ /byi bzhin dang ni gro zhun te/ de ltar sogs/ nub kyi phyogs na sogs/ nub phyogs skyong zhing nas/ mthong bar shog cig /mon gru dang ni mon bre dang*/ khrums stod dang ni khrums smad dang*/ /nam gru tha skar bra nye ste/ /rgyu skar mthu dang dpal ldan pa'o/ / de ltar sogs/ byang gi phyogs nas/ byang phyogs skyong zhing nas/ mthong bar shog cig oṃ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyis/ /lam dang lam min gnas pa bzhi/ /bkra shis ldan dang kun shes dang*/ /gang po dga' ba dpal rnams so/ zhes pa la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs btags te lan gsum/ oṃ rgyal po chen po= zhes pa nas/ dpal rnams so/ khyed rnams la gsol lo/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang*/ da ltar byung bas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bkas/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa la srung ba dang*/ yongs su skyabs pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur ba dang*/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig /oṃ lag na rdo rje'i bu mthu bo lag myur zhes bya ba grong khyer khor yug na gnas pa'o/

/na maḥsarba tā thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ oṃ lag na rdo rje'i nas/ gnas pa'o/ khyed rnams la gsol lo/ / gsol ba 'debs so= nas/ bzlog par gyis shig /oṃ stobs ldan dri med sgra chen dang*/ / rab gnyen 'jigs byed 'dzam bu mgrin/ /mchog len bla ma grags ma dang*/ /mthab dga' ma dang snang grags ma/ /rtse mo dga' dang sa 'dzin dang*/ /'thab 'jug ma ste bcu bzhi'o/ /tsa tu ra da sha mahā rak+ṇa si/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ oṃ stongs ldan= nas/ bcu bzhi'o/ / khyed rnams la gsol lo/ / nas/ bzlog par gyis shig oṃ rwa dang thub med ngan slob dang*/ /phra ma can dang bran mo dmar/ rab chen ma dang mig bzang ma/ brgyad pa 'jigs byed ma yin no/ /aṣ+ta mahā rak+ṣa si na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ oṃ rwa dang = nas/ yin no/ /khyed rnams la gsol lo= nas/ bzlog par gyis shig oṃ gzi brjid mchog dang dga' rtsegs dang*/ /sna tshogs sbyin spong de bzhin du/ /bran mo dkar bzang 'jug gdong dang*/ /grong khyer khor yug ma dang ni/ /bdun pa rigs srungs mo zhes bya/ /sap+ta mahā rak+ṣa si na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ oṃ gzi brjid= nas/ zhes bya/ khyed rnams la gsol= nas/ bzlog par gyis shig oṃ kā li mahā rak+ṣa si na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs/ srin mo nag mo chen po bu stong dang ldan pa la gsol lo nas/ bzlog par gyis shig oṃ rtag tu myos dang rjes su myos/ /stobs kyi rgyags dang 'od ma'i sbubs/ /'byor ldan ma rnams gnod sbyin ni/ /'bum phrag bdun cu rtsa bdun bcas/ /'dzam gling mi rnams srung zhing skyong*/ pañtsa mahā rak+ṣa si na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yoḥ sogs lan gsum/ oṃ rtag tu nas/ srung zhing skyong*/ khyed rnams la gsol lo/ nas/ chad pa bzlog par gyis shig ces pa'i bar bya ste/ spyir ni de tsam gyis chog la/ spros pa la dga' na/ de yan chad kyis gtor tshan re re'i 'gor/

gtor ma byin rlabs re re sbyar zhing*/ rgyal po yul 'khor srung man chad kyi gtor tshan thams cad la/ gtor ma'i rjes su ar+ghaṃ= sogs kyi mchod pa de yang 'jug gsol 'debs tshig lhug pa'i rjes su/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ sogs kyi 'dod don gsol btab te byas na yang legs par 'gyur ro/ /mchod pa'i rjes su bstod pa yang*/ rgyu skar yan chad la gong du bstan pa bzhin dang*/ de man chad kyi gtor tshan bdun po la/ bstod pa ni logs su med kyang chog mod/ spro na/ oṃ rgyal po chen po bzhi rnams kyi/ /lam dang lam min gnas pa bzhi/ /bkra shis ldan dang kun shes dang*/ /gang po dga' ba'i dpal rnams so/ /gang de'i ming rus shis pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu/ /mi dang mi min 'jig pa med/ khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ zhes dang*/ mkha' la yongs su spyod pa yi/ /grong khyer khor yug ces bya na/ /rol zhing rtse ba lag myur ming*/ /lag na rdo rje bu thu bo/ /gang de'i ming rus shes pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu/ /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa med/ / khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ stobs ldan dri med sgra chen dang*/ / rab gnyen 'jigs byed dzam bu mgrin/ /mchog len bla ma grags ma dang*/ / 'thab dga' ma dang snang grags ma/ /rtse mo dga' dang sa 'dzin dang*/ /'thab 'jug ma ste bcu bzhi'o/ / byang chub sems dpa'i sku srung ma/ /srin mo chen mo mthu chen rnams/ gang de'i ming rus shis pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu/ /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa med/ khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ oṃ rwa dang thub med ngan slob dang*/ phra ma can dang bran mo dmar/ /rab chen ma dang mig bzang ma// brgyad pa 'jigs byed ma yin no/ /skyes pa bud med gnyid log gam/ /ma log na yang gzi brjid 'phrog /gang des ming rung shes pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu*/

/mi dang mi min 'jigs pa med/ khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ gzi brjid mchog dang dga' rtsegs dang*/ /sna tshogs sbyin spong de bzhin du/ /bran mo dkar bzang 'jug gdong dang*/ /grong khyer khor yug ma dang ni/ /bdun pa rigs srung mo zhes bya/ /de dag khrag gi dri tshor na/ / dpag tshad brgyar yang rgyug par byed/ /gang de'i ming rus shes pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu/ /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa med/ khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ /srin mo nag mo chen mo ni/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i ngogs na gnas/ /nub rer dpag tshad brgyad khrir rgyug /bu ni srin po stong dang bcas// gang de'i ming rus shes pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu/ /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa med/ khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ /oṃ rtag tu myos dang rjes su myos/ /stobs kyi rgyags dang 'od ma'i spub/ /'byor ldan ma rnams gnod spyin ni/ /'bum phrag bdun bcu rtsa bdun bcas/ gang de'i ming rus shes pa la/ /rgyal po chom rkun me dang chu/ /mi dang mi min 'jigs pa med/ khyed rnams la yang bstod phyag 'tshal/ / sogs gong bzhin sbyar bas legs par 'grub bo/ /'on kyang dkyus su sbyar ba ni 'bring po nyid de/ /'di dag la gtor 'bul gyi phyag rgya pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba yin la/ gtor sngags kyi mgo'i tshigs bcad rnams ma gtogs/ tshigs bcad gzhan rnams la gdangs thung bcug nas dril gsil byed/ tshig lhug gi smon lam dang 'dod gsol gyi skabs/ gtor ma dang dkyil 'khor phyogs la me tog bor/ re re'i mjug tu rol chen dang bcas/ gtso mo lnga'i snying po bzlas pa'i mthar/ gtor mgron la 'dod gsol drag po re bya'o/ /de'i rjes su dkar gtor cha bzhi'i nang nas 'byung ba lta bu cho ga gang yang rung bas klu gtor dang gtong zhing de rjes cha gsum nas 'byung ba ltar/

'byung po spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bgegs gtor yang gtong ngo*/ /bod kyi bla ma rnams grwa lnga'i sngon 'gro gtor mar 'dod pa de yang gtso bor bgegs gtor du snang bas/ spro na skabs 'dir gtong rgyu yin mod kyi/ re zhig 'dir ma bris so/ /gal te gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa la mos na/ 'das gtor dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi dang*/ cha gsum tsam gyis kyang chog go /de nas gtso mo'i bum pa'am bum pa gcig las med na lha bum gdan gtsang ma'i steng du bshams/ sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar slar yang bum pa sgrub/ de rjes dkyil 'khor dang bum pa dang*/ dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad la dmigs nas/ zhi ba'i don du me tog dang*/ rgyas pa'i don du dur ba 'bul te/ de yang me tog bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ kuṃ yig las byung ba'i me tog kun da dkar po'i phung por gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi mahā pra ti swa re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ puṣ+pe pra tits+tsha na maḥ lan bdun gyi mthar gtor te/ dbus kyi gtso mo la me tog phul/ de bzhin du/ oṃ a mṛ ta ba re sogs gtso mo bzhi po la'ang lan bdun bdun phul te/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams kyi/ nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad shān tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na ma/ lan gsum gyi mthar me tog dor te/ pri thi bī de bā ི'i bar du sbyar/ phyogs skyong ba bcu/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byungapo'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag cag dpon slob sogs nas/ ku ru ye swā hā 'i bar/ oṃ mo go lkā yaṃ swāhā/ puṣ+paṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ lan gsum gyi mthar me tog dor de bzhin du/ dz+yo te ke ta we'i bar du sbyar te/

gza' chen po dgu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ oṃ karti ka ya swāhā/ puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha na maḥ lan gsum sogs bha ra ṇi zhes pa'i bar du sbyar/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ oṃ d+dhi ta raṣ+ta ye swāhā/ puṣ+paṃ pra tits+tsha na maḥ lan gsum sogs/ bai shra ma ṇa '-i bar du sbyar nas/ rgyal po chen po 'jig rten skyong ba ste bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob nas/ ku ru ye swāhā/ des rigs bsgres nas dur ba la yang 'bul te/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ duṃ las byung ba'i dur ba gzhon nu myu gu dang bcas pa/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad 'phel pa'i nus pa can du gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ra ṇi mahā pra ti ba re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ durba triṃ ṇa pra tits+tsha na maḥ zhes pa lan bdun gyis gtso mo la phul/ de bzhin du gzhan bzhi la'ang sbyar/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad puṣ+taṃ ku ru ye oṃ/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams la yang sbyar te/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇi ye swāhā/ durba tri ṇa pra tits+tsha na maḥ lan gsum/ rgyal po chen po 'jig rten skyong ba sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob nas/ ku ru ye oṃ/ zhes pa'i bar ro/ / dur ba rnams phyogs gcig tu sdoms te/ byang bum la sogs par bcug nas dkyil 'khor gyi byang phyogs su bzhag go /de dag ni dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ / de nas bdag 'jug mi byed na/ rjes chog tsam byas pas/ rkyen bzlog sogs rang gzhan gyi don gang la yang cho ga tshang bar 'gyur ro/

/ bdag 'jug byer par spro na/ 'jug pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūṃ/ lan gnyis kyis gdong g.yogs bcings shing*/ me tog bzung*/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ kyi bgegs bskrad/ snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa ta ya mi/ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ rdo rje snying gar gtugs/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su bzhugs kyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /a khāṃ bī ra hūṃ zhes khrid nas/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes sgo bzhi nas zhugs/ dngos su yol ba bsal ba'am bsal bar mos/ oṃ na ma te hūṃ/ na mo mī hūṃ/ na mo na maḥhūṃ/ zhes phyag 'tshal/

dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ praṃ hūṃ maṃ shaṃ gaṃ rnams su gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi yig 'bru'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas thim/ mdun bskyed bcom ldan 'das ma lnga'i thugs ka nas kyang rang dang 'dra ba'i lha tshogs dpag tu med byon te/ rang nyid kyi snying gar thim par gyur/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi mahā pra ti sa ri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra a be sha ya hūṃ/ de bzhin du sngags bzhi po'i mthar yang sbyar te ye shes phab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste bstan par bya/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig lan gsum gyis bden stobs brjod nas/ oṃ pratīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog phul/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa mahā ba la/ zhes spyi bor bcings/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa dra laṃ hri traṃ/ mig dar phye/ he badz+ra pā sh+ya/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dang ba rab tu skyed/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlabs/ /'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub dang*/

/dngos grub kun khyod mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad skyang ba dang*/ /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad mngon gsum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus skabs 'dir lha ngo ston zhing/ nad gdon gyi gtses pa dang*/ byur chags yod pa sogs la byang grol byed na yang*/ lha ngo bstan ma thag pa'i skabs 'dir byas na legs te rgyu mtshan du ma yod do/ / de nas dngos gzhi'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ oṃ mu ni mu ni mu ni ba re de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rig pa'i dbang bskur ba/ rdo rje'i go cha chen po'i phyag rgyas rgyas btab pa thams cad kyis/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya dhiṣ+ṭhi te mu dra badz+ra swāhā/ lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la slob dpon gyi gsol ba btab par yang mos te/ bdag la zhes pa 'di la zhes par 'don pa bsgyur/ de nas bum pa lnga yod na gzhan rnams kyi chu gtso bum du bsdus/ med na lha bum gcig po nyid thogs/ bdug spos brtul/ me tog mthor bzhin du/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ bum pa'i nang du/ lha lnga bzhugs pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ rang gi spyi bo nas bzhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi mahā prati pā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ lan gsum la sogs pa dang*/ de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das ma bzhi po'i sngags la'ang sbyar/ bsdu na de tsam gyis cho ga la/ spro na/ oṃ in+d+ra ya swāhā/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes pa nas/ oṃ bai she ma ṇa ya swāhā/ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes pa'i bar du yang sbyar te chu dbang bskur ro/ /de nas gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi por gtugs te/ oṃ ta thā ga ta to bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ zhes cod pan gyi dbang blang*/ de nas/

rang gi spyi bor so sor 'brang ma/ phrag pa g.yas su stong chen rab 'joms/ g.yon du rma bya chen mo/ mchan khung g.yas su gsang sngags rjes 'dzin/ g.yon du bsil ba'i tshal rnams bzhugs te/ srung ba chen po mdzad par gyur/ gnas de rnams su rdo rje gtugs shing*/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs kyis mthar/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ oṃ a mṛ ta ba re sogs/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mam/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi lo sogs/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa mam/ oṃ bi ma le sogs rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ oṃ bha ra sogs/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ oṃ in+d+ra ya sogs/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ/ zhes pa ni lha'i bsrung ba'o/ /de ni chu cod pan gyi dbang gi yan lag go /de nas slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dus yin na/ me long la sor 'brang gi snying po bris pa bum chus bkrus te/ slob ma la 'thung du gzhug pa yin/ bdag 'jug gi skabs/ khrus bum gyi chu nas cung zad btungs te/ ma ṇi dha ri sogs sngags lnga po tshar gcig brjod/ 'di la sngags kyi srung ba zhes zer yang*/ sngags dbang dngos yin pas/ de'i rjes su bzlas lung dang dam bca' ba dang byin rlabs kyi lung rnams byas kyang shin tu legs zhing*/ gang ltar yang dbang gi dngos gzhi nang tshan/ gal po che zhig yin pa zhes par bzung ngo*/ /de ni slob ma la dbang bskur na/ 'o thug sman dang bcas pa sbyin dgos shing*/ bdag 'jug la ni khrus bum gyi chu nas btungs te/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gzi brjid dang*/ /gtsug tor can gyi stobs rnams dang*/ / thams cad skyob kyi bden tshig dang*/ /log dad sel gyi ting 'dzin dang*/ / gser zhes bya ba'i ye shes dang*/ /'od srungs kyi ni rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /shākya seṅge'i mthu rnams kyis/ /sman rnams bdud rtsir 'gyur bar shog /rlung las gyur dang mkhris las gyur/ /pad dkan gyur dang 'dus las gyur/ nad rnams thams cad rab bcoms te/ khyed la rtag tu bde legs shog / de la ni kha zas kyi srung ba zhes zer te/ dga' ston gyi tshul lo/

/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ sems can rkang pa med pa'am/ rkang pa gnyis pa'am/ rkang pa bzhi pa'am/ rkang mang ngam/ gzugs can nam/ gzugs can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes can nam/ 'du shes can ma yin pa'am/ 'du shes med/ 'du shes med min gyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag las/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchog ces bya ba dang*/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshigs gang gis/ 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos ji snyed yod pa de dag gis nang nas/ 'dod chags dang bral ba mchog ces bya ba dang*/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig gang gis/ tshogs pa'am ring dus pa'am/ mang po'am/ 'khor ji snyed yod pa de dag gi nang nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun mchog ces bya ste/ bden pa dang bden pa'i tshig de rnams kyis/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod rnams la srung bar bya'o/ /yongs su skyab pa dang*/ yongs su bzung ba dang*/ yongs su skyangs ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /mtshams bcad par bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad bzlog par bya'o/ / gzi brjod 'phrog pa rnams bzlog par bya'o/ /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zad par gyur cig /med par gyur cig /zhi bar gyur cig /rab tu zhi bar gyur cig / ces pa ni bden stobs brjod pas bsrung ba'o/ /de nas rang ngam sgrub bya la me tog gtor te/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal= tshogs kyi mchog rab lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /dge bdun phyag 'tshal= 'byung po gang dag 'dir ni lhags gyur te/ /sa'am 'on te bar snang 'khor kyang rung*/ /skye rgu kun la rtag tu byams byed cing*/ /nyin dang mtshan du chos la spyod gyur cig /'di ni rgyal ba dgra rgyal bden gang gi /shin tu bden pa gsungs zhing brdzun med pa/

/bden pa de yis 'dir ni bde legs shog /de kun 'jigs pa che las thar gyur cig ces pa ni shis brdzod do/ de rjes/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te= sogs bya/ sngar bum bskyed dang*/ sta gon gyi lha'i skabs su bshad pa lta bu gang yang rung ba'i rjes mchog bya ste/ de yang mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ mchod bstod yig brgya bzod gsol rnams bya zhing rdul tshon gyi zhag tha ma yin na gshegs gsol byed tshul spyi dang 'dra/ rten gzhan rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul mtshon yin yang sgrub mchod zhag sprel ma byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams dang*/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la ni dkyil 'khor nyid la brtan bzhugs bya zhing*/ oṃ khyod ky-i sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyis mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gang ltar yang mjug tu smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub bya'o/ / ras bris la brten na thig tshon gyi bya ba nam yang mi dgos pa der gda'/ sa chog dang sta gon ni 'grub na shin tu legs shing*/ ma 'grub na dngos gzhi kho na byed pa'i lag len spyir yang mang du gda' ba dang*/ lugs 'di nyid la yang*/ lag len de ltar byed pa mang ste/ rung ba tsam du ni mngon no/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga 'di sgrubs pas/ /dge ba cung zad gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /bla med go 'phang thob par shog /ces srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba 'di yang don gnyer du mas bskul ba'i ngor/ tā ra nā thas sbyar ba ste dkyil 'khor 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams kyis chog sgrigs shin tu rgyas pa mdzad 'dug na'ang*/ 'di'am 'di lta bu dag na/ rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du bzung nas/ nyan bshad sgom sgrub lag len rtsal 'don du byed ba'i grwa da lta ni med la sngar yang ma byung zhing*/ phyis kyang 'byung dkon te des na zhor byung du byed dgos pa'i rigs 'di 'dra la/

cho ga spros pa ches na/ rtsa ba nas nub pa'i nyen yod cing*/ dus kyi tha ma 'di lta bur shes rab chung ngu'i skye bo nyi tshe lta bur snang bas 'di 'dra'i rigs la don tshang phyin khyer bde ba kho na legs par mthong ste/ de bzhin du sbyar ba yin no// // gcig zhus// ༄༅/ /gzungs grwa'i cho ga la brten nas byad 'grol byed tshul bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti na mo bud+dha ya/ 'dir gzungs grwa lnga'i cho ga la brten nas byad 'grol byed pa'i tshul la/ snying po mdor bsdus pa ni 'di yin te/ de la dang por thab bca' ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram phyogs ji ltar bde bar 'grub na zhi ba'i thab khung dngos sam/ spyi dang mthun par bris thab legs par 'du bya/ de ltar bri ba ma lcogs na/ rdza gzhong ngam lcags zangs kyi snod du/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad bris/ lha lnga'i tshom bu bkod de/ so so'i sku mdog dang mthun pa'i nges pa'am/ yang na lnga char dkar por byas pas kyang rung ngo*/ /de'i mtha' nas/ bud shing lci skongs rtsig 'dir thab ma 'grub na de tsam gyis chog /seng ldeng dang*/ rgya shugs la sogs pa'i bud shing bshad kyang*/ phyogs 'dir ji bzhin du 'byor par dka' ba'i mos pa tsam gyi rung ngo*/ /de la mchod yon dang nyer spyod lnga dang gtor ma rnams ji ltar bde bar bshams/ gzhan yang chang bu nyi shu rtsa gcig / glud gzugs gcig /yos dang 'bru dkar bsres pa/ gtan gsar pa dkar po/ tshon skud sna lnga ring po/ gri /sreg rdzas la mar khu/ yam shing*/ 'bru sna tshogs bsres pa rnams kyang bshams/ de nas sgrub bya de slob ma yin la/ skabs 'dir dbang bskur ba'ang byed rgyu yin la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa yongs rdzogs lha ngo bstan pa yan chad byas nas/ byad 'grol dngos kyi cho ga 'di la 'jug dgos la/ sngar slob ma yin yang 'dir dbang bskur ba ni mi zhu/ byad 'grol ni dgos na/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs kyis gsol ba btab/

mig dar me tog a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ deng khyod sogs gsang gdams dang*/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūṃ gi khrid/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa gzhug oṃ na maḥ sogs kyi phyag 'tshal/ dkon mchog gsum la= sogs rgyun bshags bya/ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra gyis me tog gtor/ he badz+ra kyis mig dar bsal/ de nas lha ngo bstan/ de ma thag byad 'grol gyi cho ga rnams bya'o/ /gal te sngar slob ma min zhing*/ skabs der dbang bskur zhu ba yang min no/ / sgrub byed la spos bdugs/ me tog dkar po gtor/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ lha ngo ston pa ltar dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ gtso mo lnga po gsal 'debs su bcug /'di la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa med pas yol ba gtong ba sogs mi dgos/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba lta bu'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum rjes bzlos byar bzhug /de ma thag byad 'grol bya te/ de la spyir ni gsang sngags kyi dam tshig la gnas thub pas ni byad 'grol gyi don du yang*/ dbang bskur yongs rdzogs zhu ba nyid mchog yin la/ sngags kyi dam sdom srung mi nus kyang*/ sngags dang lha la mos pa'i rigs yin na/ gong du bshad pa ltar 'jug pa'i cho ga bsdus pas dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa nyid mchog yin zhing*/ 'di yang dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir dbang bskur ba'i rigs su gtogs pa yin no/ /lha sngags la dad pa'i nges pa yang med par/ nad gdon la phan pa don gnyer tsam ka yin na/ lugs phyi ma dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa med pa ltar bya'o/ /sngar dpon slob min na'ang*/ byad 'grol gyi cho ga 'di byas phyin/ sngags chos kyi 'brel ba nges can yin pas/ byad 'grol byed pa po la bla mar bzung nas gus pa byed dgos kyi/ rtsis mkhan dang bon po'i lto chos dang 'dra bar ma bsam zhig /skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol lam/ nang du yang rung ste/ sgrub bya la bgegs sbyang ba dang*/ byur bsal ba bsdus pa til sbyang ngam/ rgyas pa drug bzhi ldan lta bu ji ltar 'os pa bya/

gang ltar na'ang sgrub bya la me tog dkar po gtor/ ma ṇi dha ri 'i sngags brjod/ gdan ji ltar 'os pa la 'dug tu bcug nas/ tshon sku sna lnga la grol mdud kyi lung mig 'dra ba/ dbus su chen po gcig dang*/ g.yas g.yon du chung ba gnyis gnyis te/ lnga byas nas/ che ba sgrub bya'i mgul la skon/ gzhan rnams srin lag gnyis dang*/ rkang pa'i srin mdzub gnyis la skon/ yang na rkang pa'i de rkang rtses non tsam byas kyang rung*/ skye bo mang po la byed dgos na yang*/ 'grub na re re bzhin du de ltar bya la/ de ltar ma 'grub na/ thams cad kyi srin mdzub nas skon zhing sbrel bas kyang rung ngo*/ /de nas 'di skad ces/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma sku mdog dkar la/ zhes pa nas/ rgyab yol can no/ / rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer gyi rtse la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ sgrub bya 'di nyid la gnod par byed pa/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi khams dang nang lus la gnas pa thams cad/ zhags pas bcings/ lcags kyus drangs shing*/ gzhan yang sdig sgrib nad gdon byur chags skal ba ngan pa thams cad bkugs ste byang thag 'di la thim/ khyad par du yang sa las byung ba bad kan gyi nad rnams tshon skud ser po la thim/ chu las gyur pa grang ba'i nad rnams dkar po la thim/ me las gyur pa khrag mkhris rnams dmar po la thim/ rlung las gyur pa rlung gi nad rnams sngon po la thim/ 'byung ba sna tshogs 'dus pa las gyur pa dang ldan pa dang*/ 'dus pa'i nad rnams ljang khu la thim par gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' 'den pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ lha rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ drang srong rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa'i lha rnams kyi bden pa dang*/

snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das ma srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di dag la 'tshe bar byed pa'i sdig pa dang*/

sgrib pa dang nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa dang*/ byad ma byur chags/ skal ba ngan pa/ dus kyi zhags pa/ gshin rje'i pho nya/ bgegs dngalog 'dren mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshon skud sna lnga pa 'di la thim par gyur cigaṭak+ki hūṃ dzaḥ zhes lan gsum 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang bcas te bya/ de nas gri gu me dang chur rim gyis bcug ste/ ma ṇi dha ri 'i sngags bzla zhing*/ 'di skad ces/ las kyi slob dpon so sor 'brang ma'i skur gyur pa'i/ phyag g.yas su ral gri thogs nas/ khyod rang rnams kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs mtha' dag 'dus pa'i ngo bo byad thag de dum bur gtub par mos mdzod/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ / sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos dang*/ /tshangs pa dang ni 'jig rten skyong*/ / gnod sbyin ded dpon dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin gnod sbyin stobs chen dang*// 'phrog ma bu dang bcas pa dang*/ /de dag mthu dang gzi brjid kyis/ /deng 'dir sgrub bya 'di dag gi /byad stems las rnams chad gyur cig /sarba ban+dha ka kho ra dha ra ts+tshe da nā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing tshon skud rnams yan lag lnga la skon pa'i sa nas mtshon kha phar gtad de bcad/ de sgrub bya de'i lus la bskor nas/ rdo rje slob ma'am sgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba'i/ nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes lan mang du brjod de snod gcig tu gsog /de nas thab bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i ye shes kyi thab khung dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhi ba'i thab khung gi mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du praṃ yig dkar la ser ba= nas/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa re re'o/ /zhes pa'i bar/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' srung ba lnga'i lha tshogs=

zhes pa nas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin no/ /mdun bskyed kyi lha la dmigs nas ye shes spyan 'dren bya/ dkyil 'khor gyi drung nas me tog bor ba blangs/ dzaḥ hūṃ sogs dang*/ me tog tshom zhig me la dor/ de nas mchod pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod= ces pa nas bi sho dha ni swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar gyi mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ rang bzhin dag pa nyid las byung*/ zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na/ so sor 'brang dang stong chen rab 'joms dang*/ / rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes su 'brang*/ /bsil ba'i tshal te ye shes lnga yi sku/ /gzungs sngags rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces so/ / bcom ldan 'das ma lnga'i thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me 'bar/ sgrub bya 'di rnams kyi nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs par gyur/ /rdo rjes rin chen phug pa dang*/ /me yis bud shing bsreg pa dang*/ /rlung gi sprin rnams gtor ba dang*/ /nyi mas nags tshal skems byed dang*/ /bden pa'i tshig ni 'di dag gis/ /byad stems las rnams tshig par shog /sarba ban+dha ka kho ra dha dz+wa la ya swāhā/ dang por lha mo lnga'i snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes btags pas mar khu phul/ 'di dgang blugs kyis phul na legs mod/ ma 'byor na snod ci bde bas phul/ sngags lnga po nyid kyi yam shing yang phul/ de nas slob dpon kyi 'bru sna sna tshogs nas 'bru tshom re 'bul ba dang*/ mchod g.yog pas sngar gyi tshon skud kyi re de dum bu dang mang por stubs/ tsho nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bcos nas/ tshon skud tsho re dang*/ chang bu re lag pa g.yas g.yon so sor bzung nas/ sgrub bya la skor ba'i tshul byas te me la 'bul zhing*/ sngags lnga po lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pa'am/ bsdu na dang por sngags lnga por tshar gcig gi mthar/ sgrub bya che ge mo'i nad gdon sdig sgrib byas kha rbod gtong mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad tshig par gyur cig

/shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes btags pa tshar gcig dang*/ de rjes ma ṇi dha ri kho na la las sngags de nyid btags pa nyi shu 'bul/ gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas/ zhes pa nas/ ka khor+dha dz+wa la ya swāhā/ sgrub bya che ge mo'i nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ bgegs dang*/ sogs gong ltar ro/ / mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes me dang sgrub bya la bum chu gtor/ me'i dbal zhi bar gyur cig gong bzhin mar dang yam shing phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig dang*/ de rjes spro na 'dod gsol rgyas par bya/ bsdu na skabs 'dir 'dod gsol med kyang chog /yig brgya bzod gsol spyi dang 'dra/ ye shes pa mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim zhes/ me tog gi snod me la bskor nas dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du bzhag /dkyil 'khor la me tog gtor/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ hoḥ de nas bar 'dir las bum gyis dkyil 'khor la khrus gsol bya ste spyi dang 'dra/ sku khrus gsol ba'i bum chu bum par blug nas/ slob dpon gyi de thogs te thog mar ku shas bum chu blangs te sgrub bya'i spyi bo nas gtor/ de rjes khrus byar gzhug cing*/ sngags lnga po tshar gcig gi mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ nad thams cad= gdon thams cad= rim thams cad= nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad= mkhon thams cad= grib dang mi gtsang ba thams cad= byad kha thams cad= byur thams cad= skal ba ngan pa thams cad= gzhan gyis mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad/ rbod gtod thams cad= ro langs kyi las thams cad= gdon kyi las thams cad= mnan pa dang 'chang ba'i las thams cad bsregs pa dang phur bus btab pa thams cad= sems g.yengs pa dang bsgyur bar byed pa thams cad= sngags dang rdzas ngan pa'i las thams cad= 'khrul 'khor dang 'khyud byed ngan pa thams cad= gza' nyes dang 'gom nyes la sogs pa thams cad= gzhan gyi las ngan pa byas pa thams cad dang*/

rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ mtshan ma ngan pa thams cad= ltas ngan pa thams cad= bkra mi shis pa thams cad= lo skeg /zhag skeg /zla skeg /dus skeg thams cad= chags che nyams nga thams cad= sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i gnod pa thams cad= dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad= mtshan mo nag mo'i gdon thams cad= dus kyi zhags pa thams cad= gshin rje'i pho nya thams cad= bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad = gza' dang rgyu skar gyi gnod pa thams cad= rgyal po dang the rang gi gnod pa thams cad= btsan dang dmu'i gnod pa thams cad= bdud dang mdangs 'phrog gis gnod pa thams cad= klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa la sogs pa mdor na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ de nas dug zhi bar byed pa ni/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzi brjid dang*/ /rang rgyal dag gi gzi brjid dang*/ / dgra bcom rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa thams cad dang*// shā ri'i bu yi shes rab dang*/ /mau 'gal bu yi rdzul 'phrul dang*/ /ma 'gags pa yi mig dang ni/ /'og bsrungs sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*/ /ko ṭi n+ya gyi sngar thob dang*/ /kun dga' bo yi thos pa dang*/ /tshangs pa lha yi byams pa dang*/ /brgya sbyin gyi ni dbang rnams dang*/ /'jig rten skyong ba'i yul rnams dang*/ /dbang phyug chen po'i stobs rnams dang*/ /sde dpon rnams kyi mthu dag dang*/ /'phrog ma'i gzi brjid rdzu 'phrul dang*/ /de dag rnams kyi mthu dang gzis/ /sgrub bya'i dug zhi dug med shog /dug med dug rnams 'jig byed shog /s+ya d+ya the than ha ri ke shi na ki le ri hi ri a ma ri an+ṭare/ pan+ṭa re/ ke yū re/ ha se ha se ha re/ kha se kha se/ mi ru ga te na swāhā/ mu mu k+ṣu swāhā/ hi le swāhā/ mi le swāhā/ 'bras dang rma dang shu ba dang*/ / g.yan pa dang ni 'brum bu dang*/ / lhog pa dag dang g.ya' ba ni/ /bdun pa lags te rab tu bcoms/

/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug rnams/ /'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum yin/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas gzi yis dug bcom mo/ /de bzhin/bcom ldan dam chos= 'phags pa'i dge 'dun zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di yi su/ /dug gsum sa yin nang du song*/ de bzhin du/ chu me rlung rnams la yanga'adon pa spo'o/ /de nas byabs pa ni/ sngar gyi khrus sder dri khu dang bcas pa'i nang du/ glud gzugs gcig bcug /sgrub bya'i kha ru bum chu cung zad 'dzin du bcug la/ sngags thung lnga po'i mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes sogs gong dang 'dra ba las shīn+taṃ ku ru zhes pa'i sar/ a pa na ya zhes 'don pa spos la/ byabs pa'i mthar/ sgrub bya 'di nyid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs phra zhing phra ba rus la zhen pa thams cad nag bun gyi skyugs nas glud gzugs la thim par mos shig byas la/ kha nang gi bum chu glud gzugs la pho/ 'dir byabs pa'i rdzas ni/ rtsa ku sha /rma bya'i mdongs/ bya rog gi dang sgro/ yungs dkar gyi thum bu dang*/ me long ral gri dar tshon sna lnga te/ rdzas bdun ldan zha ེ sa bshad do/ / de nas/ slob dpon skad cig gis khro bo chen po gshin rje gshed/ ral gri dang zhags pa 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ na mo sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa zhes pa nas/ bden pa'i byin gyis rlabs gyi/ rdo rje slob ma'ang sgrub bya 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs log 'dren mi mthun par byed pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'di ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig / ces yungs kar gyis brabs/ gu gul gyis bdug /drag sngags dang rol chen gyis mtshams bcad do/ /khrus khu dang glud gzugs chu bo'am/ bzhi mdor skyal/ de nas rgyal ba brjod pa na/ sangs rgyas rnams ni bdud las rgyal/

/chos ni chos ma yin las so/ /dge 'dun mu stegs rnams las rgyal/ /dbang po lha min rnams las rgyal/ /lha min zla ba las rgyal lo/ / nam mkha' lding ni rgya mtsho las/ /me ni shing rnams kun las rgyal/ /chu ni me las rgyal bar gyur/ /rlung ni sprin las rnam par rgyal/ /rdo rje yi ni rin chen phug /lha rnams bden par rab tu gnas/ /sa yang bden par gnas pa lags/ /sangs rgyas dang ni chos kyang bden/ /bden pas rgyal gyur brdzun ma lags/ /sdig pa thams cad rab tu pham/ /phyir rgol kun las rgyal bar gyur / swāhā/ sgrub bya rnams slob dpon gyi lag gi rdo rje la 'jus te/ oṃ dza ye bi dza ye swāhā/ dza ya dza ya zhes brjod cing gdan dkar po gsar pa me tog dkar po gsar pas gtor ba la bzhag / de nas bsrung ba ni/ slob dpon gyis sgrub bya'i gnas bdun du rdo rje rgya gram bzhag bas/ rdo rje'i go skon par mos te/ sngags thung lnga po'i mthar/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes sogs gong bkru byab kyi sngags rnams la rak+ṣa zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /mdor bsdus la dga' na de tsam gyi byad 'grol 'grub pa yin pas/ skabs 'dir shis brjod rnams bya la/ yang cung zad spros pa la mos na/ bar 'dir sngon gyi grwa lnga pa rnams rig gtad kyi tha snyad mdzad pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di bya ste/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'das ma bsrung ba lnga'i lha tshogs la/ zhu ngo'i tshul gyis slob ma'am/ sgrub bya 'di la bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*/ nye bar 'tshe ba rnams bsrung ba dang*/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes zhus pas lha rnams kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes shing dgongs pa gtad par bsams nas/ na mo bud+dha ya*/ zhes pa nas/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te mu dra badz+re swāhā/ zhes pa'i bar/ so sor 'brang ma'i gzugs sngags chen mo tshar gsum skad bsangs mthon pos klog /'di la nges par dpe klogs mdzad pa lag len yin pa 'dug

/de nas dbang bskur dngos gzhi byed na maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba man chad gong bzhin bya la/ dbang bskur mi byed na/ lha dang sngags kyi bsrung ba mi bya/ kha zas kyi bsrung ba dang*/ bden stobs brjod pa dang/ shis brjod rnams dkyil chog bzhin bya ste/ shis brjod ni lhag par rgyas pa byas na'ang legs la/ dbang bskur dang ma 'brel na/ kha zas kyi bsrung ba'i skabs/ 'brang rgyas dkar po lta bu'i dpal zas btad kyang rung ngo*/ /lag len phra mo mthong ba rgyud pa las shes par bya zhir/ legs par dpyad pas kyang rtogs par 'gyur ro/ / sdoms ni/ thab khung bca' zhing yo byad gsog /sngon 'gro 'jug pa'i dbye ba dang*/ /slob ma gsangs dang tshon skud skon/ /rang lhar bskyed dang dgug gzhug dang*/ /byad thag bcad nas lus la byab/ /thab lha bskyed cing mchod bstod bya/ /mi mthun phyogs bsreg rjes chog dang*/ /lha la khrus gsol sgrub bya bkru/ /dug zhi ba dang byab pa dang*/ /rgyal bar brjod nas gtan la bzhag /bsrung ba byas te shes pa brjod/ /yang na bsrung ba rigs gtad dang*/ /zas mchog bden stobs bkra shis rgyas/ /zhes bya'o/ /thog mar bgegs sbyangs byur gsal ba/ byas na'ang shin tu legs pa nyid/ /ces pa ste gzungs grwa lnga'i cho ga la brten te byad 'grol byed tshul gyi lag len shin tu 'khyer bde ba 'di yang*/ dkyil mchog bar chad kun sel gyi cha lag tu rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas bris ba'o// // bkra shis// dge legs 'phel// zhus dag/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/gzungs grwa lnga'i dkyil chog bar chad kun sel dang byad grol byed tshul bzhugs/ -PAGE 160--PAGE 159--PAGE 155-
